page.layout: One page of text, single column. Page number at the top right. No running head. No catchword. Signature "Xx" at the foot left.

main_text.p: canem contubernalem Valeriano dilacerare tentaverat. Vale ex Musaeo nostro IV. Nonas Novembris MDCXXX.
main_text.head: FRANCISCVS MOLINVS Canonicus Patauinus. Eidem.
main_text.p: Ioannis Papissae fabulam, prauorum figmentum, Hæreticorum commentum semper recta indicavit lance; tum quia illius temporis Scriptores, tam Catholici, quam Hæretici, de ea ne verbum quidem, sed fideli historica-successione, Leoni IV. Benedicto III. Benedicto Nicolaum, Nicolao Adrianum &c. sufficiunt. Cum etiam mihi nunquam in animum inducere potuerim, Spiritum sanctum, qui de fide universali aflat Ecclesia contra Iesu Christi, & Dei institutum, hoc monstrum, & portentum in Ecclesia dedecus permisisse. Hinc Reverendissime Domine, summa animi voluptate, spiritalique gustu diligenter perlegi, quae abs te mihi missa sunt hac de re Leonis Allatii scripta. Vere Leo animalium princeps Leonis ad instar inter omnes aurea corona, regalique sceptro donandus; vere Allatus, cum se ad sublime super omnes evexerit. Dignum quaeso mecum adiudica, vt de eo Ecclesia Romana, quam ex Hæreticorum sordibus, & squalloribus exemet,

page.notes: The first line continues from the previous page. The date line "MDCXXX" is printed as an ordinary Roman numeral. The signature "Xx" at the foot is a gathering mark and is therefore not transcribed as text. Long s has been normalised to s. "Papissae" is printed "Papiffa", read as Papissae. The u/v and i/j spelling has been normalised to the classical forms, as required. The reading "aflat" (printed) has been kept as printed. The line "Allatij" has been normalised to "Allatii". The printed hyphen at "historica-" and "exe-" is kept, and the words are joined only where a printed hyphen stands.
